observations.interpretation: These are materially stronger than screenshots/papers: they expose actual tool calls, code and gate/rejection trace for selected runs.

observations.claim: The galaxy_xsurvey log exposes full ideation/experiment/writeup trace and explicit exit-gate PASS/REJECT events, including executed run_python code and resulting numbers. Searches of that observed log for source_revision, commit, and claude-sonnet yielded no run-source or model-revision identifier.
observations.tested_scope: Observed public replay log at the pinned site revision only; absence claims are limited to searched identifier strings/metadata, not all conceivable hidden provenance.

observations.claim: The replay site revision itself postdates the 2026-08-13 arXiv submission; replay blob identity therefore supplies current public trace identity but does not, by chronology alone, prove which source tree/gate revision/model produced the paper-time evaluation.
observations.interpretation: TRACE_REPLAY_OBSERVABILITY and EVALUATED_RUN_SOURCE_REVISION_BINDING are separate provenance levels.

handoff_boundary.safe_positive_claim: Three selected run traces are public, immutable at the cited site revision, and rich enough to audit many tool/code/gate events.
handoff_boundary.unsafe_upgrade_without_bridge: Do not use those three replays as a certificate for all 36 evaluated cases or for paper-time source/gate/model identity unless a manifest explicitly binds them.
remaining_minimum_bridge: model identity/revision and relevant inference settings
36-case run manifest linking each case to trace/result/gate report
statement linking later replay artifacts to the historical evaluated executions
